name: application-quantity-inputs
title: Quantity Inputs
description: Quantity input components for number inputs, ideal for ecommerce, order forms, and shopping carts.
useWhen: Quantity input components for number inputs, ideal for ecommerce, order forms, and shopping carts.
avoidWhen: Avoid quantity inputs when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Quantity Inputs uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
